payout_quote: M&T Bank personal checking promotion: open a new eligible M&T personal checking account by December 31, 2026 and receive up to $300 — $300 on MyChoice Premium or MyChoice Plus ($250 on some co-branded pages), $200 on EZChoice — with qualifying direct deposits totaling $500+ within 90 days of account opening; bonus awarded within 90 days after completing the direct deposits.
timing: Bonus awarded within 90 days after completing the qualifying direct deposits.
steps: Go to mtb.com's Checking Account Cash Bonus and Promotions page and enter your ZIP to see your footprint's exact offer.
Open a new eligible M&T personal checking account (MyChoice Premium or Plus for the $300 tier; EZChoice for $200) by December 31, 2026.
Set up qualifying direct deposits totaling at least $500 within 90 days of account opening.
Keep the account open and meet a fee waiver; the bonus is awarded within 90 days after you complete the direct deposits.
catches: DUPLICATE: R0049 ('M&T Bank Checking') and R0079 ('Manufacturers and Traders Trust (M&T)') are the same offer — Manufacturers and Traders Trust Company is M&T Bank's legal name. Treat as one offer.
Bonus is tiered by account type: $300 MyChoice Premium / MyChoice Plus, $200 EZChoice; MyWay Banking is ineligible for a bonus.
Requires opening by 12/31/2026 and qualifying direct deposits totaling $500+ within 90 days of opening.
Offers and products may vary by location (ZIP-code prompt on campaign pages); co-branded variants have their own expiries (Ravens 10/31/2026, UConn 10/8/2026).
Monthly maintenance charges apply: MyChoice Plus $14.95/mo, MyChoice Premium $24.95/mo (waivable); account must remain open until bonus is awarded.
Source limitation: exact promo page URL was not directly readable — terms confirmed via official mtb.com and campaigns.mtb.com crawls; re-confirm on the live page before presenting.
biggest_catch: This is the same offer under both route IDs (Manufacturers and Traders Trust = M&T Bank's legal name) — and the $300 tier requires the Premium/Plus account, which carries a $24.95/$14.95 monthly maintenance fee if not waived.
eligibility: New M&T personal checking customers 18+ within the M&T footprint (exact offer varies by ZIP); new account by 12/31/2026.
notes: Verified 2026-09-23 via official mtb.com and campaigns.mtb.com crawls (exact promo URL not directly readable — see standard.s7).
